name: server-data
title: Server Data
description: React hooks for a PageSource on TanStack Query, behind signatures of their own: useServerPage, useServerTotal, useServerInfinite, useInvalidateSource, useSourceMutation and usePageController, with DataProvider and createDataClient for the defaults.
docs: `useServerPage(source, request)` loads one page with the query key `[...source.key, "page", filter, sort, position, size]`: the previous rows stay while the next page loads (`previous`), a superseded request is aborted through its signal, and it returns `items`, `status` (`pending`, `error`, `success`), `fetching`, `total`, `navigation`, `error` and `retry`. When the source has `fetchTotal`, `useServerTotal` counts beside it, a query of its own that never holds the rows back. `useServerInfinite(source, { filter, sort, size })` adds page after page (`loadMore`, `hasMore`, `loadingMore`) by page number or cursor. `useInvalidateSource(source)` refreshes everything under the source's key; `useSourceMutation({ mutationFn, source, optimistic })` refreshes it once the change settles, and `optimistic: (items, variables) => items` shows the change at once and restores the rows if it fails. `usePageController(source, options)` keeps a `createPageController` for the component's life and follows the URL while mounted. The hooks use the app's `QueryClient` when one is provided; otherwise a shared default, so nothing has to be mounted. `DataProvider` provides one with `createDataClient` defaults when the app has none: two retries except on a 4xx (read from the error's `status`), 30 s fresh, no refetch on window focus. With server rendering, mount a `DataProvider` per request. `useDelayedFlag(active, episode)` turns true once a load has taken 400 ms, for a status that says "Loading…" only when it matters, and `useReachEnd(onReach, enabled)` is a ref that runs `onReach` when an element scrolls into view, for infinite lists.
